witness.quote: No person shall park a vehicle in an access aisle.
witness.reason: The one-way-road parking task can terminate in a qualifying marked access aisle.
required_context: Establish jurisdiction, parking footprint, purpose and actual loading activity.
Establish jurisdiction, qualifying vehicle, responsible person and unresolved NRS-definition applicability.
Establish the ingress, egress and accessible-route design relationship and qualifying markings.
If relying on LVMC 11.52.135(A) for designation, preserve its access-symbol, minimum-fine wording or equivalent, and minimum four-foot sign-bottom height requirements.
Provide a supported approach from the one-way road and retain the complete parking footprint relative to aisle boundaries.
Realize aisle boundaries adjacent to a designated handicapped parking space.
Realize an adjacent designated handicapped parking space, qualifying aisle markings and the ingress, egress and accessible-route design relationship.
Record purpose and actual loading activity without treating duration alone as the parking test.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver can be the person parking an ordinary motor vehicle.
